model.summary: Model favors MIN by 0.3 points (52% win chance). Biggest factors: Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (MIN +2.2), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (BUF +1.9), Quarterback rating (BUF +1.9). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 47.8 total points (MIN 24, BUF 24). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 2.0), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.1), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
